Maria T. Rodriguez

Maria T. Rodriguez is a judge on the Los Angeles County Superior Court in California.

Rodriguez was appointed to the bench by Governor Gavin Newsom on March 15, 2022. She was retained in the November 2024 general election.

Education

  • B.A., University of California, Berkeley, 2005
  • J.D., Stanford Law School, 2008

Career

Rodriguez's career prior to her appointment included the following:

  • Associate, Morrison & Foerster LLP, 2008-2012
  • Deputy District Attorney, Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office, 2012-2018
  • Senior Deputy District Attorney, Los Angeles County District Attorney's Office, 2018-2022
